title: Finite-cover locality of bounded constructibility and a fixed Tor interval
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] whose underlying topological space is Noetherian, meaning that every descending chain of closed subsets stabilizes. Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and let $X=\bigcup_{i=1}^r U_i$ be a finite open covering, with open immersions $j_i:U_i\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-open-immersion]; $r=0$ is allowed if $X$ is empty. Use the small pro-etale sites, constant coefficient ring sheaves, and derived categories of module sheaves of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $K\in D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ and let $a\leq b$ be integers. Write $K_i=K|_{U_i}$ for derived restriction. Write $\mathcal H^t$ for cohomology sheaves [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Assume that for each $i$ only finitely many $\mathcal H^t(K_i)$ are nonzero, and each $\mathcal H^t(K_i)$ has a finite partition of $U_i$ into locally closed constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset] subschemes (with their reduced induced structure) on which its pullback is locally constant [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf] with finite $A$-module stalks. Assume also that for every degree-zero sheaf $F_i$ of $A$-modules on $(U_i)_{\mathrm{proet}}$ one has
$$\mathcal H^t(K_i\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}F_i)=0\quad(t\notin[a,b]),$$
using derived sheaf tensor [def-weil-derived-tensor]. Then each $\mathcal H^t(K)$ has a finite partition of $X$ into locally closed constructible subschemes on which it is locally constant with finite $A$-module stalks, and for every degree-zero sheaf $F$ of $A$-modules on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ one has
$$\mathcal H^t(K\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}F)=0\quad(t\notin[a,b]).$$
In particular $\mathcal H^t(K)=0$ for $t\notin[a,b]$, so $K$ is bounded constructible with Tor amplitude in that same interval.
